title: ADR-0144 amendment: a child row and a roll-up follow the parent record currency through master_detail (ruled A, 6739066323)
body:
domain:devx#2 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTo666XXx9e1Gm21C6

Filing gate: an out-of-scope finding from card #27197 (showcase `invoice` goes multi-currency), step-1 reading 6730090645, handed to the spec lane by seat ruling on that card. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Problem

A record-currency header (an invoice with a currency code and a record amount) cannot make its children follow that currency:

- A child object's currency field cannot point `currencyField` at the parent's currency code. The key resolves only within the child's own fields.
- A summary (roll-up) over a child whose amount is in record mode is refused.

So on a EUR invoice, the line items and the Subtotal roll-up render with the home-currency symbol, while the header shows EUR.

## Ask (for the spec seat to shape)

Decide whether `currencyField` may name a parent path (for example the lookup's target field), and whether a roll-up over record-mode children is allowed when every child follows the same parent currency. Or rule that line items stay home-currency, and say how an example should present it.

## Reader

`domain:spec`, from triage. #27197 will land without this. Its showcase keeps line items and the Subtotal in the home currency and says so.

Related: #27192, #27196 (the home amount and record currency work), epic #8345.
